subject.title: Control UI: app sessions panel styles leak into Chat detail panels

question: Should this protected issue be manually closed as resolved by merged PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103561, or retained for a dedicated Chat detail-panel geometry test?
rationale: Current `main` removed the conflicting sessions-panel architecture, but repository policy forbids automated closure of an item carrying the `maintainer` label and the remaining test-coverage preference is a maintainer choice.

options.title: Close as resolved
options.body: Close manually because current `main` removed the conflicting app-panel owner and leaves `.sidebar-panel` scoped to Chat.

options.title: Retain for coverage
options.body: Keep open only to add an explicit Chromium assertion that Chat detail wrappers have zero outer padding and edge-aligned headers.

recommendation.title: Close as resolved
recommendation.body: Close manually because current `main` removed the conflicting app-panel owner and leaves `.sidebar-panel` scoped to Chat.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete, who authored both the superseding architecture change and the explanation closing the obsolete focused fix PR.
